About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Head of Strategic Startups at Anthropic, you will own the strategy, organization, and commercial outcomes for Anthropic's relationships with the world's most important AI-native startups. This is the segment where the next generation of category-defining companies is being built on Claude, and where Anthropic's commercial, product, and partnership decisions compound fastest.

You will lead a team of Account Executives who own Anthropic's most strategic AI-native accounts, and be accountable for a revenue line spanning expansion, retention, and net-new strategic wins. Beyond running the business, you will define what "strategic" means for Anthropic in the startup ecosystem: which companies we bet on, how we structure partnerships with them, how we engage investors and accelerators, and how the signal from this segment shapes our product roadmap and go-to-market model.

You will be a member of the GTM leadership team and a visible voice for Anthropic in the startup and venture community, helping ensure that the companies defining the future of AI choose to build it safely, and with us.

Responsibilities:

•

Set the multi-year strategy for Anthropic's Strategic Startups business, including segmentation, coverage model, partnership structures, and investment priorities, and secure executive alignment on it

•

Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Account Executives, including hiring, coaching, and developing sellers and establishing a strong operating cadence across the team

•

Own the segment's revenue plan and P&L-level outcomes, including forecasting, capacity planning, quota design, and resource allocation, with direct accountability to GTM and company leadership

•

Personally lead Anthropic's relationships with a portfolio of the highest-leverage AI-native startups, engaging founders, CEOs, and CTOs on multi-year commercial, technical, and partnership agreements

•

Design and negotiate novel commercial and partnership structures (credits programs, strategic pricing, co-development, joint go-to-market) that create durable, mutually beneficial relationships with breakout companies

•

Serve as the executive voice of the startup segment inside Anthropic, bringing structured customer and market insight to Product, Engineering, Pricing, and Finance and influencing roadmap and packaging decisions accordingly

•

Partner with Enterprise Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, and Customer Success leadership to define handoffs, shared accounts, and escalation paths as startups scale into enterprise customers

•

Establish the systems of record for the segment: account planning, customer health, executive business reviews, deal governance, and the metrics leadership uses to run the business

•

Represent Anthropic externally with founders, investors, and at industry events, articulating our approach to safe, frontier AI and why it matters for companies building on it

•

Lean in to support building Anthropic's presence across the startup ecosystem.

You may be a good fit if you:

•

Have 15+ years of experience in enterprise or technical software sales, with 7+ years leading sales teams

•

Have been a founder or have worked previously as a Business Development leader securing large contracts.

•

Have owned a significant revenue line with full accountability for plan, forecast, and results, and have a track record of consistently outperforming it

•

Have built or materially scaled a sales or account management organization, including designing coverage models, compensation plans, and operating rhythms

•

Bring deep, first-hand familiarity with the startup ecosystem, including relationships with founders, venture investors, and accelerators, and an instinct for identifying which early-stage companies will become the ones that matter

•

Have sold or led sales of technical, consumption-based, or platform products (APIs, infrastructure, developer tools, ML/AI), and are credible in conversations with technical founders and CTOs

•

Have structured and closed complex, non-standard commercial and partnership agreements at the executive level

•

Are a strong cross-functional leader who has influenced product, pricing, and go-to-market decisions well beyond your own organization

•

Are analytically rigorous and comfortable making decisions with imperfect data in a rapidly evolving market

•

Are motivated by Anthropic's mission and care about how frontier AI is deployed, not just how fast it grows

Strong candidates may also:

•

Have led a startups or emerging-companies segment at a cloud, infrastructure, or AI platform company through a period of hypergrowth

•

Have founder, operator, or venture experience, and understand the pressures and decision-making of a high-growth startup from the inside

•

Have built ecosystem programs (startup credits, accelerator partnerships, investor programs) that meaningfully drove adoption of a developer platform

•

Have hired and developed leaders who went on to run their own organizations

•

Have experience leading through a market where the product and competitive landscape shifts quarterly

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$550,000—$750,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

The Team

Cortex Platform - The Cortex Platform team is responsible for developing and maintaining the backend of Cortex products, including Cortex XSOAR, Cortex XDR, and Cortex XSIAM. The team focuses on developing, innovating, and scaling the Cortex Platform, along with contributing to shared Cortex infrastructures and components, to bring value to thousands of customers.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Cortex backend engineering group. In this role, you will be pivotal in developing, innovating, and scaling the Cortex Platform, contributing to shared infrastructures and components. This position is for a passionate engineer with a can-do attitude, who thrives on solving complex problems and delivering significant value to our global customer base by enhancing our Cortex product suite.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end backend development of features and core components through the entire lifecycle, from design and development to testing, deployment, and maintenance.
• Proactively collaborate and exchange information with peers across different teams and disciplines to design and integrate effective solutions.
• Engage with customers to understand their challenges and provide robust technical solutions that address their day-to-day operational needs.
• Contribute to team-wide technical and architectural decisions, participating actively in code and design reviews to ensure quality and alignment.
• Design, build, and maintain high-scale, distributed server-side applications, ensuring reliability and performance.
• Focus on the details of implementation to ensure the simplicity and maintainability of code for shared Cortex infrastructures and components.
• Apply learning from new technical challenges to continuously improve system architecture and development processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including designing and building scalable server-side applications.
• Proven experience with a variety of database technologies, including both RDBMS and NoSQL systems.
• Demonstrated experience in designing and working with distributed cloud products and microservices architecture.
• Proficiency in Python or Go programming languages.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
• Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
• Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

The Xfinity Sales Professional (XSP) is responsible for promoting and selling XFINITY Residential products and services within assigned multi-dwelling unit (MDU) properties and communities. XSP is primarily focused on door-to-door canvassing within multiple dwelling units, targeted in-building sales activity, and selling at approved MDU community, promotional, and sales events. This is a field-based position that offers a combination of working from home and in the field, with occasional travel to the office (approximately 5% of the time) for key team meetings and trainings. We’re open to candidates located anywhere in the Atlanta area north to Cumming, GA, and Spanish bilingual candidates are strongly preferred.

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Role Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented candidate to join our team as a Financial Accountant in Revenue and Inventory Accounting. This role supports core accounting, settlements, and operational processes of our retail business, including but not limited to cost accounting and inventory analysis, invoice processing, AP management, vendor funding, etc. It partners with stakeholders from FP&A, Brand Management, Global Sourcing, Fulfillment Center, Marketing, Customer Service to enable business initiatives with a strong emphasis on operational efficiency, alignment with group accounting policies, regulatory compliance, and superior user experience across the organization.

What You Will Do:

Financial Operations

• Assist in managing timeliness and accuracy of inventory cost recognition.
• Support multiple-dimension cost analysis to identify opportunities for business optimization.
• Take part in end-to-end P2P process including AP approval, invoice validation and reconciliation, vendor settlement, and payment term review.

Process Improvement and System Optimization

• Identify process gaps and pain points from end-user and stakeholder perspectives.
• Help the redesign of workflows to improve efficiency, transparency and user experience.
• Assist in developing clear SOPs, guidelines, and training materials.
• Participate in discussion of system development requests with IT.
• Support solution design, testing and data validation for system-related projects.

Compliance and Controls

• Ensure conformity of transaction records to relevant accounting standards.
• Support compliance with tax and regulatory requirements.
• Assist in documentation and testing of internal controls adhering to internal control frameworks.

Accounting Closing & Reporting

• Execute necessary process to facilitate monthly closing and preparation of financial statement packages.
• Gather and validate supporting documentation in response to requests from internal and external auditors, tax authorities, as well as regulatory bodies.
• Assist in preparation and quality review of financial disclosures and other filings as required.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 3–7 years of accounting, audit or tax experience, preferably in a multinational environment.
• Fluency in English and Mandarin for day‑to‑day communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work cross-functionally and with external parties.
• High attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving ability.
• Proactive, independent, and capable of managing multiple deadlines.
• Experience working with external auditors and tax consultants.
• Strong understanding of financial statement preparation and related disclosures.
• Solid knowledge of local tax regulations and international tax concepts.
• Familiarity with SOX compliance framework.
• Proficiency in Excel and ERP systems (e.g., SAP).

Preferred Qualifications:

• CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification.
• Big 4 Accounting firm experience.
• Proven involvement in finance process improvement initiatives or finance system implementation projects.
• Prior experience with PCAOB audits or in a public company environment.

This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction. Key job responsibilities The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. A day in the life Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy. Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion. About the team Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.

jobs.description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 16 The Team: The Market Outreach team is a strategic function within S&P Global Ratings responsible for building and strengthening relationships with the global investment community and other key market participants. The team acts as the voice of the market within Ratings, helping ensure that investor perspectives inform business priorities, analytical thought leadership, and commercial strategy. As Global & Americas Head of Market Outreach, you will lead the global Market Outreach organization while maintaining direct accountability for the Americas region. You will oversee a geographically dispersed team responsible for engaging buy-side investors, asset owners, private market participants, and other influential stakeholders across public and private credit markets. This role combines leadership of the current Global Head of Market Outreach and Americas Head of Market Outreach mandates into a single strategic leadership position. The role will partner closely with Analytical leadership, Commercial leadership, Regional Heads of Sales, Growth & Enablement (Product), Marketing, Research, Compliance, and senior management across Ratings to ensure market engagement is coordinated, compliant, insight-led, and aligned with enterprise priorities. The Impact: This is one of the most visible external-facing leadership roles within S&P Global Ratings. You will be responsible for defining and executing a global market outreach strategy that strengthens S&P Global Ratings' position as a leading provider of credit ratings, research, and market insights. Through direct engagement with investors and industry leaders, you will ensure the organization remains closely connected to evolving market dynamics, emerging risks, investor sentiment, and new growth opportunities. The role is instrumental in supporting strategic priorities across traditional fixed income, structured finance, private credit, fund finance, private markets, insurance, asset management, and other evolving capital market sectors. A key objective is to generate actionable market intelligence that helps shape commercial strategy, supports analytical excellence, and informs executive decision-making across the organization. Success in this role requires the ability to operate with a global enterprise perspective, influence senior stakeholders internally and externally, lead through complexity and ambiguity, and represent S&P Global Ratings as a recognized market thought leader. What's in it for you: Lead one of the most respected orgnizations in the credit markets industry. Build relationships with senior investors, asset owners, alternative investment firms, insurers, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, advisors, and other influential market participants across the globe. Shape the future direction of Market Outreach, including expansion into strategic growth segments such as private credit, fund finance, asset owners, and private markets. Influence enterprise-level decisions through the delivery of strategic market intelligence and investor insights. Partner directly with senior leaders across Ratings, Commercial, Growth & Enablement (Product), Research, Marketing, and Corporate functions. Build and maintain senior-level relationships with influential investors, asset owners, insurers, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, private credit managers, fund finance participants, asset managers, and other market stakeholders. Ensure S&P Global Ratings remains closely connected to evolving market trends, investor sentiment, emerging risks, and new areas of market opportunity. Generate and disseminate actionable investor insights that support analytical excellence, commercial growth, strategic planning, and executive decision-making. Partner closely with Analytical leadership, Commercial leadership, Growth & Enablement (Product), Marketing, Research, and other stakeholders to coordinate market engagement efforts and maximize enterprise impact. Serve as a senior representative and brand ambassador for S&P Global Ratings at conferences, executive forums, client meetings, and industry events. Drive thought leadership initiatives that enhance S&P Global Ratings' visibility, credibility, and influence within global capital markets. Leverage technology, AI, and data-driven approaches to strengthen market intelligence capabilities and improve organizational effectiveness. Establish appropriate KPIs and performance metrics to measure outreach effectiveness, strategic impact, and market engagement outcomes. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous development across the global team. Ensure all Market Outreach activities are conducted in compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week. This role requires up to 50% travel domestically and globally. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here . Demonstrated success leading global or multi-regional teams and delivering results through complex matrixed organizations. Deep understanding of global credit markets, institutional investors, private markets, structured finance, and fixed-income investing. Track record of building trusted relationships with senior market participants and executive stakeholders. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and communicate effectively across markets, cultures, and organizational levels. Experience developing and executing strategic initiatives that create measurable business impact. Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and influence outcomes without direct authority. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Product Manager for the Research team at Anthropic, you will own the ideation and deployment of new models and products as we advance frontier, safe AI technology. You will work closely with our research teams to help productize credible applied research and identify high-potential use cases grounded in customer needs. We are looking for someone passionate about developing safe and beneficial artificial intelligence technologies. You thrive in ambiguous environments and can uncover latent, non-obvious use cases for nascent technologies, bringing these insights back to research. Your curiosity about user needs enables you to connect advanced technology to products that deliver real-world value.

We seek experienced founders and product managers who can bridge research and ambitious product experimentation, with the ability to create and grow entirely new product categories enabled by AI.

Responsibilities:

• Lead vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution of frontier technologies that leverage the latest AI capabilities to solve real-world problems
• Partner with research to define, improve, and ship model capabilities within a research area
• Identify nascent research that could become transformative products
• Synthesize user insights into actionable requirements and evaluations
• Understand the AI landscape and ecosystem, ensuring we have an objective view of market capabilities and our position
• Work with and influence a diverse set of stakeholders, including research, product engineering, and platform engineering teams

Minimum Qualifications

The ChatGPT organization at OpenAI supports our mission by bringing advanced AI capabilities to hundreds of millions of users worldwide. The Image Generation team is responsible for one of the fastest-growing experiences in ChatGPT, enabling users to create, edit, and transform images through natural language.

Recent breakthroughs in multimodal AI have dramatically improved image quality, instruction following, editing precision, consistency, and text rendering. We're building the systems and experiences that turn these research advances into products used daily by creators, professionals, businesses, and consumers around the world.

Our team sits at the intersection of research, product, design, and infrastructure. We work closely with model researchers, mobile engineers, frontend engineers, and platform teams to build intuitive experiences and scalable systems that power image generation at global scale. We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join the Image Generation team and help shape the future of AI-powered visual creation.

You'll work across the entire stack—from highly interactive user interfaces and real-time workflows to backend services, APIs, orchestration systems, and data infrastructure.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy moving fluidly between product development and systems engineering, collaborating closely with design, product, and research teams to rapidly bring new AI capabilities to users.
